description: BTC drop during FTX collapse, Nov 8-9 2022. Binance announced FTT liquidation Nov 6 after CoinDesk's Nov 2 Alameda balance sheet expose; mass FTX withdrawals followed; BTC fell below $16,000 (lowest since 2020) as contagion spread. Correct explanation should cite the exchange-crisis news, not the distractor.

candidate_news.headline: Binance to liquidate entire FTT position, citing 'recent revelations'
candidate_news.summary: Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao announced the exchange will sell its remaining FTT holdings, worth over $500 million, following reports about Alameda Research's balance sheet being heavily concentrated in FTX's exchange token.

candidate_news.headline: FTX halts customer withdrawals amid liquidity crisis
candidate_news.summary: FTX has suspended all crypto withdrawals after seeing an estimated $6 billion in withdrawal requests in 72 hours. Fears of exchange insolvency are driving selloffs across all major crypto assets.

candidate_news.headline: Bitcoin mining difficulty adjustment scheduled this week
candidate_news.summary: The Bitcoin network's regular difficulty adjustment is expected this week, a routine protocol event that occurs approximately every two weeks.

ground_truth.documentation: Wikipedia: Bankruptcy of FTX; CoinDesk Nov 8 2022 'FTX Token Falls 80%... Contagion Spreads to Bitcoin' - BTC fell to 23-month low as FTX halted withdrawals

description: BTC move around the SEC spot Bitcoin ETF approval, Jan 10 2024. A long-anticipated regulatory approval - the correct explanation cites the approval news. Includes a bearish distractor to test that the agent picks the directionally-coherent cause.

candidate_news.headline: SEC approves spot Bitcoin ETFs after decade of rejections
candidate_news.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission approved multiple spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds, allowing mainstream investors direct exposure to bitcoin through traditional brokerage accounts for the first time.

candidate_news.headline: Analyst warns of possible crypto winter extension
